title: TAI runner input and evidence boundary restoration
objective: Restore deterministic pcactions access to the bounded runner-input parent after every protected controller execution, remove current-run secret inputs on activation or deployment exit, and preserve root-only state plus pcactions-readable redacted evidence without widening sudo or Docker authority.
requiredBehavior: keep /var/lib/pc-release-authority root:pcactions mode 0710 after every controller exit
keep runner-input root:pcactions mode 0730 so the non-root runner can create only bounded per-run input directories
remove the current activation or deployment input directory through the root controller on both success and failure
reject symlink or non-directory current-run input state during cleanup
keep protected repository and controller-jobs root:root mode 0700
keep runner-output root:pcactions mode 0750 and evidence files root:pcactions mode 0640
preserve the original controller result unless boundary restoration itself fails
retain exact-current-main, restricted sudo, no direct Docker authority and no production inbound SSH
forbiddenCapabilities: arbitrary sudo or arbitrary filesystem cleanup
runner access to protected repository, controller state or model private key
tenant, role, financial, veterinary, agronomic or autonomous write-authority expansion
acceptance: static contract proves runner-input restoration and bounded current-run cleanup
exact head remains behind_by=0 with zero unresolved review threads
all required CI, security, runtime and Kubernetes gates PASS
owner preflight PASS followed by a fresh activation run that can prepare its input directory
redacted activation evidence remains readable by the runner
